response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications including C programming for UNIX embedded systems, Linux kernel modification experience, native Japanese proficiency, and any demonstrated background in network security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X) or embedded switch firmware development, despite extensive experience in web, mobile, and general-purpose software.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex open-source systems
Proven track record in DevOps, CI/CD, and developer tooling
concerns: No evidence of C programming in UNIX/embedded contexts or Linux kernel work
Lacks native Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement
No experience with LAN-switch security technologies, networking protocols, or embedded hardware control
